title: Emergent Bias and Fairness in Multi-Agent Decision Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating difference-based group fairness metrics (e.g., Accuracy Parity, Equalized Odds, Precision Parity, False Positive Rate Parity) between male and female demographic groups on tabular financial classification tasks (Adult Income and German Credit Risk datasets) to compare the outputs of individual LLMs against multi-agent systems.
